primaryTextChecks.text: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.

context.text: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.
Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.

geographicalEvidence.reasonJa: ネゲブ北部の古代地名とされるが、本文だけで現代遺跡を確定することはできない。
